verdict.rationale: Users can order shredding of physical mail items, including through the official MCP server ('scan or shred a piece of mail'), which is a user-invoked deletion control. Retention, however, appears to follow fixed vendor terms: unlimited cloud storage for digitized mail and 30/10-day physical holds, with no user-configurable setting documented. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention policies, documented deletion of digitized scans and cloud data, account-level data purge/export controls, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: take real actions on your behalf: scan or shred a piece of mail, apply tags or move it to a different folder
Unlimited cloud storage applies to digitized mail. Physical mail is stored for up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages
